sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance is defensive: Q1 subscription and services revenue is guided down to $550M–$630M from Q4's $727M, reflecting lower crypto prices, rates, and rewards. Transaction revenue through February 10 is $420M, but management cautions against extrapolation due to volatility. The GAAP net loss of $667M is driven by unrealized crypto losses, not operational issues, but the lowered subscription guide and flat expense outlook signal caution rather than growth. The score is slightly negative because guidance was reduced, not held flat.

summary.revenue: Q4 total revenue $1.8B, down 5% Q/Q. Full-year 2025 revenue $7.2B, up 9% Y/Y.
summary.eps: Not disclosed. GAAP net loss $667M, driven by $718M unrealized loss on crypto portfolio and $395M loss on strategic investments including Circle.
summary.guidance: Q1 2026 transaction revenue about $420M through February 10 amid heightened volatility. Q1 subscription and services guided down to $550M–$630M on lower crypto prices, rates, and rewards. Expenses expected flat Q/Q.
summary.margin: Not disclosed. Adjusted EBITDA $566M in Q4.
key_risks: Crypto market cap fell 11% in Q4, and softness is reflected in the subscription guide.
Brief platform interruptions affected core buy, sell, and transfer functions.
$718M unrealized loss on crypto portfolio and $395M loss on strategic investments including Circle.
Lower average crypto price environment, lower interest rates, and lower staking protocol rewards rates expected in Q1.
key_opportunities: Global trading volume and market share both doubled year over year to all-time highs.
Everything Exchange launched in Q4, with early success in derivatives, prediction markets, and equities.
Stablecoin adoption: USDC stored in Coinbase products hit an all-time high, USDC market cap reached ~$75B.
Base chain set new transaction all-time high, with AI agents adopting stablecoin wallets.
12 products generating over $100M annualized revenue; subscription and services revenue up 5.5x from 2021 peak.

management_tone.label: mixed
management_tone.justification: Management expresses confidence in long-term positioning ('I'm more bullish than ever') but also provides defensive guidance ('we're focused on flat for the first quarter') and acknowledges headwinds ('lower average crypto price environment').
